# Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri

Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri (RHP) is the psychiatric service of [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], one of five Danish regions covered by the ADHD-Databasen, a national quality database tracking assessment and treatment pathways for children and adolescents with ADHD [^src1]. According to the 2023 annual report for the database, RHP does not meet the standards set for the database's performance indicators [^src1]. This finding appears in an appendix section of the report that compiles regional statistics on assessment pathways, population calculation rules, and regional commentary on capacity problems, incomplete registration, physician shortages, and difficulties meeting assessment deadlines — factors that affect regions' ability to satisfy the database's standardized indicators.

The entity's stated significance is that it works toward improvement through optimized registration practices, though the specific measures are not detailed in the available excerpt.

The available source material is limited to a single mention and a single claim; no relationships or timeline events involving RHP are recorded in the corpus.
